dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「――ってことで、時間も時間だからこれで撤
　収にしよう。週番、挨拶」
dialogues.en: "And that ends the class. Weekly duty, rise."
dialogues.text: "And that ends the class. Weekly duty, rise."

dialogues.jp:
出席簿で机を軽く叩いて、暦先生が挨拶をすす
める。
dialogues.en: After calling out attendance, Koyomi bade us farewell.
dialogues.text: After calling out attendance, Koyomi bade us farewell.

dialogues.jp: 「よしっ！」
dialogues.en: "All right!"
dialogues.text: "All right!"

dialogues.jp: 机の下で小さくガッツポーズを作った。
dialogues.en: I make a small guts pose under my desk.
dialogues.text: I make a small guts pose under my desk.

dialogues.jp: 通常の授業終了よりも５分ばかり早い。
dialogues.en: She ended the class 5 minutes earlier than usual.
dialogues.text: She ended the class 5 minutes earlier than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「起立……礼」
dialogues.en: "Stand... bow."
dialogues.text: "Stand... bow."

dialogues.jp: した〜。
dialogues.en: Done~.
dialogues.text: Done~.

dialogues.jp:
敬愛する暦先生に頭を下げつつ、下半身にエネ
ルギーをためていく……補足しておくが足だ。
足。
dialogues.en:
I bow with respect and affection for Koyomi-sensei, while my
lower half was tingling... meaning my leg, really.
dialogues.text:
I bow with respect and affection for Koyomi-sensei, while my
lower half was tingling... meaning my leg, really.

dialogues.jp:
（このまま昼休みになると、１時間さくらんぼ
　に絡まれるからな……）
dialogues.en:
"(Although at this rate, during lunch period, I'm almost
certainly going to get entangled into Sakura again...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Although at this rate, during lunch period, I'm almost
certainly going to get entangled into Sakura again...)"

dialogues.jp:
――と走り出したいのだが、いかんせん、避け
られた時のアイツの顔を想像してしまって足踏
みが鈍っていた。
dialogues.en:
--The sight of her face in my mind's eye made me stop in my
tracks.
dialogues.text:
--The sight of her face in my mind's eye made me stop in my
tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに微妙に中腰なの兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What's with that body position, nii-san?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that body position, nii-san?"

dialogues.jp:
お財布を確認しながら、音夢が横を通り過ぎよ
うとする。
dialogues.en: Holding her purse, Nemu walked past my side.
dialogues.text: Holding her purse, Nemu walked past my side.

dialogues.jp: 「珍しいな……弁当でも忘れたか？」
dialogues.en: "That's odd... did you forget your lunchbox?"
dialogues.text: "That's odd... did you forget your lunchbox?"

dialogues.jp:
日によって食事の形態を変える俺とは違って、
音夢は買い置きの弁当をできるだけ持ってきて
いるはずだが。
dialogues.en:
Unlike myself who eats at the cafeteria nearly every day,
Nemu usually brings a lunchbox from home.
dialogues.text:
Unlike myself who eats at the cafeteria nearly every day,
Nemu usually brings a lunchbox from home.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「違うの……今日だけは食堂かどっかで食べる
　の」
dialogues.en: "Noo... I just felt like eating at the cafeteria today."
dialogues.text: "Noo... I just felt like eating at the cafeteria today."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと拗ねた雰囲気の声が、俺だけに届く。
dialogues.en: She talked to me with a slightly sulky voice.
dialogues.text: She talked to me with a slightly sulky voice.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで今日だけなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why today?"
dialogues.text: "Why today?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もぅ……この年頃の女の子は複雑なのよ」
dialogues.en: "Sigh... because of the girl with puberty problems."
dialogues.text: "Sigh... because of the girl with puberty problems."

dialogues.jp:
クルリと小さく回転して、そのまま音夢が教室
を出て行く。
dialogues.en: Rolling her eyes a bit, Nemu left the classroom.
dialogues.text: Rolling her eyes a bit, Nemu left the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm."

dialogues.jp:
音夢にまでわけの分からないことを言われて、
どうにも思考がまとまらない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't really understand what Nemu meant, but decided not
to think too much about it.
dialogues.text:
I didn't really understand what Nemu meant, but decided not
to think too much about it.

dialogues.jp: 「……少し中和しておこう」
dialogues.en: "...I should be going too."
dialogues.text: "...I should be going too."

dialogues.jp: ジー、っと背伸びしていた眞子の顔を見つめた。
dialogues.en:
As I turn around, Mako's face is the first thing in my
vision.
dialogues.text:
As I turn around, Mako's face is the first thing in my
vision.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……ん？　なに、やぶからぼうな視線送って
　んのよ」
dialogues.en: "...Huh? What's with that look."
dialogues.text: "...Huh? What's with that look."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、なんでもない。むしろ、そのパンチの
　効いた｛にら／睨｝みがたまらない」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing. Just trying to perfect a scowl to neutralize your
punch."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing. Just trying to perfect a scowl to neutralize your
punch."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……また馬鹿ばっか。お姉ちゃん待ってるか
　ら、あたし行くからね」
dialogues.en:
"...Still being stupid. Onee-chan is waiting for me, I'm
going now."
dialogues.text:
"...Still being stupid. Onee-chan is waiting for me, I'm
going now."

dialogues.jp:
手を振りかえしながら、｛さっそう／颯爽｝とした背中を見送
る。
dialogues.en: With a wave of my hand, I see her back off.
dialogues.text: With a wave of my hand, I see her back off.

dialogues.jp: 「さて」
dialogues.en: "Now then."
dialogues.text: "Now then."

dialogues.jp:
廊下への扉に手をかけながら、行き先を決める
ことにした。
dialogues.en:
Opening the door to the corridor, I decided on my lunchtime
spot.
dialogues.text:
Opening the door to the corridor, I decided on my lunchtime
spot.

dialogues.jp: ◆授業終了◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lessons Over◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lessons Over◆

dialogues.jp:
通常よりも５分早く授業が終わった。よしっ、
と小さくガッツポーズ。
dialogues.en:
Class ended 5 minutes earlier than normal. I cheered and did
a small guts pose.
dialogues.text:
Class ended 5 minutes earlier than normal. I cheered and did
a small guts pose.
